context:
Goal: reviews only use verdicts you asked for.
Problem (rule): PR #2326 builds a WIDE verdict. No owner words, decision or step names it; the ledger rows disagree (#2365 drop, #2326 keep).
Based on (code): the debt note wide-plain-copy-unpinned and #2326's own code are the only traces.
Departs from: main — main has no WIDE verdict; choosing b adds it.
Meanwhile: the review-record lane builds no WIDE.

options.gain: No code with no ruling behind it.
options.how: The review-record lane drops the WIDE verdict; #2365 drops it, #2326's copy goes.
options.label: WIDE is not built (triage's pick)
options.lose: A reviewer cannot give a verdict of WIDE.

options.gain: A reviewer can mark a change as too wide.
options.how: The review-record lane keeps WIDE from #2326.
options.label: WIDE is built
options.lose: Code with no record of why you wanted it; the ledger rows disagree.

title: Should the review record carry a WIDE verdict?
why: Triage took this pick (not built); it stands unless you choose b.
